blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Telecom language models must combine broad networking knowledge with specialist behavior across routing, broadband services, access technologies, and operational diagnostics while remaining practical to deploy as a single model. We present an end-to-end framework that builds source-grounded synthetic training data from structured networking taxonomies and expert graphs, materializes 212,559 routed training records across fourteen networking routes, trains six frozen specialist LoRA teachers over one shared continued-pretrained backbone, and consolidates their behavior into one deployable student adapter using Routed Specialist On-Policy Distillation (RSOD). In RSOD, the committed student generates each trajectory, the route-assigned specialist teacher-forces the exact native token sequence, compact teacher hidden states are reconstructed through the shared frozen output head, and only the student LoRA is updated. A controlled reconstruction validation shows mean absolute logit error of 7.26 x 10^-6 with 100% top-1 agreement between native and reconstructed teacher logits. On four RTX 6000 Ada GPUs, the completed 2,000-step run produced 16,000 trajectories with zero observed student-version or token- ID mismatches. Under the primary route-conditioned evaluation over 2,850 held-out questions, the raw Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model scores 12.8661/25 micro (13.0172/25 macro), the combined routed six-teacher system scores 21.7641/25 micro, and the consolidated RSOD student, released as Llama-CalixCLM v1, reaches 21.7112/25 micro (21.8006/25 macro) on the same five dimension LLM-judge rubric. Under a separate neutral deployment-like prompt, the same student reaches 20.0028/25 micro (20.0778/25 macro). The consolidated student remains within 0.0529 micro-score points of the combined routed-teacher system while retaining a numerically validated and auditable train-serve execution path.
blocks.zh: 电信语言模型必须把广泛的联网知识与跨线路、宽带服务、接入技术和业务诊断的专业行为结合起来,同时保持实用,作为单一模型加以部署。 我们提出一个端到端框架,从结构化的网络分类和专家图表中构建基于源的合成培训数据,在14条网络路线上实现212,559条路由式培训记录,在一个共享的、经过预先培训的骨干上培训6名冻结的专家LORA教师,并利用Routed On-Political Dispiration(RSOD)将其行为整合为可部署的学生适配器。 在RSOD中,执着的学生产生每个轨迹,路线指定的专家师资部队通过共享的冷冻输出头重建准确的本地符号序列,紧凑的教师隐藏状态,只有学生LORA更新. 受控重建验证显示的绝对对数误差为7.26 x 10^-6,本地与重建的教师日志之间100%的顶级-1协议. 在4台RTX 6000 Ada GPU上,完成的2000步运行产生了16000个轨迹,观测到的学生版或符号标识不匹配. 根据2,850个搁置问题的主要路由评价,原始的Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型得分12.8661/25微分(13.0172/25宏),合并的路由六师制得分21.7641/25微分,作为Llama-CalixCLM v1发布的合并RSOD学生在同一个五维LLM-judge rumic上达到21.7112/25微分(21.8006/25宏). 在单独的中性部署般的快板下,同一个学生达到20.0028/25微(20.078/25宏). 合并后的学生仍保持在路由-教师系统0.0529微分点范围内,同时保留经数字验证和可审计的列车服务执行路径.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Telecom language models must combine broad networking knowledge with operationally specific behavior across routing, transport, broadband services, access technologies, command-line diagnosis, and troubleshooting. Specialist adaptation can sharpen domain behavior, but deploying multiple specialist endpoints complicates model management and serving. Our framework keeps one shared backbone, trains lightweight specialist LoRA adapters, and then consolidates their behavior into one student adapter for deployment.
blocks.zh: 电信语言模型必须将广泛的联网知识与跨路线、运输、宽带服务、接入技术、指令线诊断和故障排除等具体业务行为结合起来。 专家适应可以强化域行为,但部署多个专家端点会使模型管理和服务复杂化. 我们的框架保持一个共享的主干线,训练轻量级专家LORA适配器,然后把他们的行为整合成一个学生适配器进行部署.

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient adaptation keeps the backbone frozen while learning low-rank updates [ 2 ] . We extend that foundation into a complete telecom post-training workflow spanning structured domain data, continued pretraining (CPT), specialist adaptation, routed on-policy distillation, auditable train–serve synchronization, and networking-specific evaluation.
blocks.zh: 参数高效的适应在学习低级更新的同时使骨干保持冻结 [2]. 我们把这个基础扩展到一个完整的电信培训后工作流程,涵盖结构化域数据、持续预训(CPT)、专家改造、政策分解路线、可审计的列车(serve intact)和针对网络的评估。

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the workflow. Our research question is: Can multiple telecom-specialized LoRA teachers be consolidated into one deployable adapter using student-on-policy distillation while retaining route-conditioned specialist quality and exact token/version consistency? In the evaluated run, the raw model scores 12.8661/25 micro, the combined routed six-teacher system scores 21.7641/25 micro, and the consolidated student reaches 21.7112/25 micro under the primary route-conditioned protocol; all 16,000 recorded version checks and token-ID checks match.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • An end-to-end telecom specialization framework connecting structured knowledge-grounded data generation and 212,559 routed training records to six specialist groups, fourteen canonical routes, specialist LoRA post-training, consolidation, and evaluation. • RSOD with exact routed supervision : the committed student generates the trajectory, deterministic route ownership selects one frozen specialist, and the teacher scores the student’s exact native token IDs before forward-KL optimization of only the student LoRA. • A memory-conscious execution architecture that shares one tensor-parallel teacher backbone across specialist LoRAs, transports compact teacher hidden states for local logit reconstruction, and maintains gradients and optimizer state only for the student LoRA. • A fourteen-route telecom networking evaluation protocol with fixed route-specific system prompts and a common five-dimension scoring framework applied consistently across compared models. • An auditable RSOD execution protocol and evidence layer combining version-consistent rollouts, exact-token specialist supervision, compact teacher-state reconstruction, machine-verifiable token/version provenance, numerical fidelity validation, and matched systems/quality measurements.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Knowledge and on-policy distillation. Knowledge distillation trains a student to match a teacher distribution using soft targets [ 1 ] . Generalized Knowledge Distillation (GKD) addresses autoregressive train–test mismatch by training on student-generated trajectories [ 3 ] . Nemotron-Cascade 2 applies multi-domain on-policy distillation from strong intermediate teachers [ 12 ] , while Ma et al. study multi-teacher on-policy distillation for capability integration [ 13 ] . RSOD specializes this design space around deterministic telecom route ownership, exact-token teacher forcing, compact teacher-signal transport, and version-consistent train–serve synchronization.
blocks.zh: 知识和政策提炼。 知识蒸馏训练学生用软目标匹配教师分布[1]. 通用知识消化(GKD)通过学生生成的轨迹培训解决自转列车的测试不匹配问题[3]. Nemotron-Cascade 2应用了强中教师的多领域政策蒸馏[12],而Ma等人. 研究多教师政策提炼,促进能力整合[13]。 RSOD将这个设计空间专门围绕确定性电信线路所有权,精确的脚踏实地的教师强迫,紧凑的教师信号运输,以及版本一致的列车—服务器同步.

blocks.en: Specialist consolidation and model merging. Multi-teacher methods study example-wise teacher selection and aggregation [ 4 ] . Parameter-space methods such as TIES-Merging combine specialized models directly [ 14 ] . RSOD instead performs behavioral consolidation: specialist adapters remain frozen and separate while one student learns from the assigned teacher on its own trajectories.
blocks.zh: 专家整合与模式整合. 多教师方法研究以实例为主的教师选拔与汇总[4]. 参数空间方法,如TIES-Merging直接结合了专门模型[14]. RSOD转而进行行为整合:专业适配器保持冷冻和分离,而一名学生通过自己的轨迹向指定的教师学习.

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient and multi-adapter serving. LoRA provides frozen-backbone low-rank adaptation [ 2 ] . Punica and S-LoRA establish shared-backbone serving for many adapters [ 5 , 6 ] , and SGLang provides an efficient inference runtime [ 7 ] . RSOD uses shared multi-adapter serving inside a synchronized training loop in which successive rollouts use the newly committed student version.
blocks.zh: 参数高效和多适应器服务。 LORA提供冷冻后骨低档适应[2]. Punica和S-LORA建立共享后骨服务于许多适配器[5,6],SGLang提供高效的推论运行时间[7]. RSOD使用共享的多适应器在同步训练循环中服务,连续推出时使用新承诺的学生版本.

blocks.en: Telecom models and evaluation. TeleQnA, TelecomGPT, TeleMath, Tele-LLMs, NETLLMBENCH, and the GSMA Open-Telco benchmark effort motivate telecom-specific evaluation beyond general-purpose language-model scores [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 15 , 11 , 16 ] . Our evaluation applies the same route-specific prompt and five-dimension scoring protocol to the raw model, the routed CPT+specialist teacher system, and the consolidated student.
blocks.zh: 电信模式与评价. TeleQnA、TelecomGPT、TeleMath、Tele-LLMs、NETLLMBENCH和GSMA Open-Telco基准努力激励了超出通用语言模式分数的电信特定评价[8、9、10、15、11、16]。 我们的评价对原始模型、路由CPT+专业教师系统以及综合学生采用同样的路线专用的即时和五分分校评分协议。

blocks.en: 3 Domain Data and Specialist Post-Training
blocks.zh: 3 域数据和专家培训后

blocks.en: 3.1 Knowledge-Grounded Corpus Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 知识型公司建设

blocks.en: Training data are produced through a structured knowledge-generation pipeline rather than assembled as a flat question–answer collection. For each networking domain, a protocol taxonomy defines the intended knowledge space and is expanded into an expert graph containing concepts, protocol fields, semantic relationships, workflows, operational behavior, failure modes, and diagnostic evidence. Graph nodes, semantic edges, and higher-order subgraphs are converted into generation units. A planning stage translates each unit into explicit learning obligations and CPT/SFT generation intents, after which a teacher model realizes the corresponding natural-language records.
blocks.zh: 培训数据是通过结构化的知识生成管道生成的,而不是作为统一的问答收集。 对于每个网络域,一个协议分类学定义了预定的知识空间,并被扩展为包含概念,协议域,语义关系,工作流程,操作行为,失败模式,以及诊断证据的专家图. 图形节点,语义边缘,以及更高顺序的子图被转换成生成单元. 规划阶段将每个单元转化为明确的学习义务和CPT/SFT生成意图,之后一个教师模型实现相应的自然语言记录.

blocks.en: The underlying technical knowledge is source-derived, whereas the final training records are synthetic realizations. Depending on the domain, the knowledge-building stage draws from standards and RFCs, protocol registries, architecture and specification documents, vendor-neutral technical documentation, implementation evidence, operational troubleshooting knowledge, and selected vendor documentation when implementation behavior is not fully specified by standards. Synthetic generation is therefore used for linguistic realization rather than unconstrained knowledge creation: CPT passages, explanations, questions, scenarios, comparisons, diagnostic exercises, and misconception-correction examples are generated from the structured representation.
blocks.zh: 基础技术知识来自源头,而最后的培训记录则是合成实现。 根据不同领域,知识建设阶段来自标准和RFCs,协议登记,架构和规格文件,中性供应商技术文件,实施证据,操作故障解答知识,以及标准未充分规定实施行为时的选定供应商文件. 因此,合成生成被用于语言实现,而不是不受约束的知识创造:CPT段落,解释,问题,情景,比较,诊断练习,以及错误理解-校正实例都是从结构化的表示中产生的.

blocks.en: Validation is applied throughout the pipeline. Taxonomy and graph stages are checked for structural coverage, atomicity, missing concepts, relationships, and weakly grounded nodes; planning checks verify that learning obligations map to CPT/SFT intents; generated corpora are checked for missing or extra planned records, empty outputs, identifier duplication, exact duplication, repeated textual patterns, planner/meta-instruction leakage, placeholder content, length distributions, and diversity. Diagnostic evaluations used during pipeline development could inform taxonomy and graph refinement. The final 2,850-question held-out benchmark reported in this paper was frozen separately and was not used to drive taxonomy, expert-graph, or training-data revisions.
blocks.zh: 整个管道均适用验证。 对分类学和图表阶段进行结构覆盖、原子学、缺失的概念、关系和薄弱的基点;规划检查核实学习义务与CPT/SFT意图的映射;对生成的企业群进行检查,以查明缺失或额外计划记录、空产出、标识重复、精确重复、重复文本模式、规划者/元指令泄漏、占位者内容、长度分布和多样性。 管道开发过程中使用的诊断性评价可以为分类学和图表的完善提供参考。 本文件中所报告的最后2 850项搁置基准被单独冻结,没有用于推动分类学、专家图或培训数据的修订。

blocks.en: 3.2 Routed Training and Held-Out Inventory
blocks.zh: 3.2 定向培训和预留库存

blocks.en: The executed experiment materializes 212,559 routed training records across fourteen canonical routes and six specialist groups. The same route identity is carried from data preparation into specialist ownership, deterministic teacher selection, and route-specific evaluation. Each routed JSONL artifact is recorded with a SHA-256 identity in the preparation manifest. Training and held-out artifacts are physically separate: CPT and specialist SFT consume routed train files, while the evaluation inventory contains 2,850 held-out questions in independently hashed files.
blocks.zh: 已执行的实验在14条峡谷路线和6个专家小组上实现了212 559个路由培训记录。 同样的路线身份从数据编制到专家所有权、确定教师的甄选以及特定路线的评价。 每个经过路由的JSONL文物在准备清单中记录有SHA-256的身份。 培训和被扣留的文物是物理上分开的:CPT和专家SFT消耗经过路线的列车文件,而评价清单则包含独立散列文件中的2,850个被扣留的问题.

blocks.en: 3.3 Shared CPT Backbone and Specialist LoRAs
blocks.zh: 3.3 共享的CPT背骨和专家LORAS

blocks.en: The shared backbone starts from a pinned Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct snapshot and undergoes full-parameter continued pretraining over the fourteen routed training files. The executed CPT run consumes 212,559 records, records 47,975,711 training tokens, and completes 3,322 optimizer steps. The CPT stage uses sequence length 1,024, one epoch, bfloat16 precision, fused AdamW, learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} with a linear schedule and 10 warmup steps, per-device batch size 1, gradient accumulation 16, and an effective global batch size of 64 across four GPUs.
blocks.zh: 共享骨干从被钉住的Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-指令快照开始,并在14个路由培训文件上接受全参数的持续预训. 执行的CPT运行消耗了212,559个记录,记录了47,975,711个训练符,并完成了3,322个优化步骤. CPT级采用序列长度1,024,1个纪元,bfloat16精度,引信AdamW,学习速率10−5 10^{-5},具有线性时间表和10个热量步骤,每装置批量尺寸1,梯度累积16,有效全球批量尺寸64跨4个GPU.

blocks.en: Each of the six specialist teachers is then trained as a separate LoRA adapter over the same CPT checkpoint. Each specialist consumes only the routed training records assigned to its specialist group; across all six specialists these assigned subsets partition the same 212,559-record routed training inventory used by CPT, while the SFT stage applies instruction formatting and three specialist-specific epochs rather than another full-corpus CPT pass. All specialists use rank 64, α = 128 \alpha=128 , dropout 0, learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0, maximum gradient norm 1.0, micro-batch size 1, gradient accumulation 8, and three SFT epochs with seed 42. The adapted modules are q_proj , k_proj , v_proj , o_proj , gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj ; maximum sequence length ranges from 1,024 to 1,536 according to specialist domain.
blocks.zh: 之后,这6名专业教师中的每一位都作为单独的LORA适配器在同一个CPT检查站接受培训。 每个专家只使用分配给其专家组的路由培训记录;在所有6名专家中,这些指定子集将欧洲防止酷刑委员会使用的同一212 559个记录的路由培训清单分割开来,而SFT阶段则采用指示格式和三个专门时代,而不是另一个全团的欧洲防止酷刑委员会通行证。 所有专家都使用64级,α=128 α=128,辍学率0,学习率2×10−5 2\times 10×5},体重衰减0,最大梯度规范1.0,微囊尺寸1,梯度累积8,以及三个SFT带种子42的时代. 改造后的模块为q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj,gate_proj,上_proj,下_proj;根据专业领域,最大序列长度从1,024到1,536.

blocks.en: During RSOD, teacher adapters, token embeddings, backbone, final normalization, and output head remain frozen; only the student LoRA parameters receive gradients. blocks.en: 4 Routed Specialist On-Policy Distillation
blocks.zh: 4名按路线排列的专家

blocks.en: RSOD overview. Routed Specialist On-Policy Distillation (RSOD) consolidates multiple frozen domain-specialist LoRA teachers into one student LoRA without merging teacher weights. The current student generates its own trajectory, a deterministic route map selects exactly one specialist teacher, and that teacher scores the student’s exact native token sequence by teacher forcing. The teacher returns final hidden states rather than dense vocabulary logits; the trainer reconstructs the teacher distribution locally through the shared frozen final normalization and LM head, computes forward KL on generated positions, updates only the student LoRA, and refreshes the new student version before the next rollout.
blocks.zh: RSOD综述. 路由化专家(RSOD)将多个冻结域专家(LORA)的教师合并成一个学生(LORA)而不合并教师的权重. 现时的学生会产生自己的轨迹, 确定性路线图选择一名专业教师, 老师返回最终隐藏状态,而不是稠密词汇日志;教练员通过共享的冻结最终正常化和LM头在当地重建教师分布,在生成的位置上计算前进KL,只更新学生LORA,并在下一次推出前刷新新学生版本.

blocks.en: 4.3 Compact-Signal Fidelity Validation
blocks.zh: 4.3 契约-标志性Fidelity验证

blocks.en: We validate the hidden-state transport path independently with a controlled single-GPU RSOD test that executes fresh student initialization, student rollout, teacher forcing, shared LM-head logit reconstruction, KL computation, backpropagation, and a student update. For a 50-token trajectory, native teacher logits and logits reconstructed as W LM ​ g ​ ( h T ) W_{\mathrm{LM}}\,g(h_{T}) are compared at all 50 generated positions over the full 128,256-token vocabulary. The reconstructed logits show mean absolute error 7.26 × 10 − 6 7.26\times 10^{-6} , median absolute error 0, maximum absolute error 6.25 × 10 − 2 6.25\times 10^{-2} , cosine similarity 1.000000, and 100% top-1 agreement. Exact top-5 and top-10 ranking matches are 98% and 94%, respectively. The native-versus-reconstructed distribution KL is numerically zero to floating-point precision ( − 4.04 × 10 − 9 -4.04\times 10^{-9} as computed), while the student-versus-teacher KD loss remains nontrivial at 1.1992. Student parameters receive gradients and change after the optimizer step. These measurements show that shared-head reconstruction preserves the teacher prediction distribution to high numerical fidelity while retaining a usable distillation signal for the student.

blocks.en: 4.4 Version-Consistent Adapter Commit
blocks.zh: 4.4 版本一致的适应器提交

blocks.en: After optimization, the student adapter is saved as a candidate, loaded by the tensor-parallel inference service, acknowledged with a changed service identity, and atomically committed before the next rollout. This enforces a version-consistency invariant: the next trajectory must come from the acknowledged committed student. Two additional invariants complete the execution contract: teacher forcing consumes the exact native student token IDs, and transported teacher hidden states reconstruct the intended teacher distribution through the shared frozen output components. The run records expected and serving adapter versions, hashes student-generated and teacher-forced token arrays, and retains route, configuration, synchronization, and telemetry evidence. All 2,000 commits completed successfully and all 16,000 recorded version and token-identity checks matched; the controlled reconstruction test independently validates teacher-signal fidelity. Mean prepare-to-commit latency is 6.47 s versus 7.65 s for student rollout.
blocks.zh: 优化后,学生适配器作为候选人保存下来,由拉诺平行推论服务加载,确认服务身份变更,并在下一次推出前进行解剖承诺. 这强制执行了一个版本一致性的不常态:下一个轨迹必须来自公认的有献身精神的学生。 另有两个变化无常者完成执行合同:教师强迫消耗准确的本地学生代币身份,运输教师隐藏状态通过共享的冷冻输出组件重建预定的教师分配. 运行记录了预期的和服务的适配器版本,散列了学生生成的和教师强制的符号阵列,并保留了路由,配置,同步,以及遥测证据. 所有2 000项承诺都顺利完成,所有16 000项记录的版本和符号标识检查都匹配;控制下的重建测试独立验证了教师的忠诚度。 学生推出课程的平均准备时间为6.47秒,而7.65秒。

blocks.en: The evaluated workstation contains four NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation GPUs (49,140 MiB each). Two GPUs run DDP student optimization; the other two host a TP2 inference service containing one shared backbone, six frozen teacher adapters, and the current student adapter. The system is evaluated as a workstation-scale four-GPU configuration.

blocks.en: 5.2 Measurement Methodology
blocks.zh: 5.2 计量方法

blocks.en: GPU memory, utilization, and power are sampled through NVML. Energy is estimated by trapezoidal integration over valid power samples; intervals larger than 2.5 times the per-GPU median sampling interval are counted as telemetry gaps and excluded rather than silently interpolated. Phase latencies are rank-0 host-boundary observations without inserted CUDA synchronization; they characterize the end-to-end control path rather than individual GPU kernels.

blocks.en: 6 Networking Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6 联网评价

blocks.en: 6.1 Evaluation Conditions
blocks.zh: 6.1 评价条件

blocks.en: The primary evaluation is route-conditioned by design: each held-out item is paired with a fixed route-specific system prompt corresponding to its canonical networking route. The same item-level route prompt is used for every compared model, so raw-model, CPT+specialist-teacher, and student scores are evaluated under the same held-out manifest, prompt construction, decoding setup, judge configuration, aggregation, and failure policy. This measures answer quality under the intended operating condition in which route-specific expertise is supplied to the model. We additionally evaluate the final student under a neutral deployment-like prompt, using the same benchmark and scoring framework, to quantify performance without the route-specific expert instruction.
blocks.zh: 初级评价以设计为条件:每个被搁置的物品都配有与其犬网路线相对应的固定路线专用系统即时. 每一个比较模型都使用相同的物品级路由提示,因此原始模型,CPT+专业教师,学生的分数都根据相同的被搁置清单,即时构建,解码设置,法官配置,汇总,以及失败政策来评价. 这一措施在向模型提供特定路线专门知识的预期运作条件下满足了质量要求。 我们还利用同样的基准和评分框架,在一个中立的部署般的即时下对最终学生进行评价,以量化成绩,而不提供特定路线的专家指导。

blocks.en: The 2,850-question held-out inventory is stored separately from the routed training files. Each route contributes 190 questions except BNG/subscriber management, which contributes 380. The judge configuration uses the Anthropic alias claude-sonnet-4-5 with temperature 0, a 2,000-token judge response limit, and a 60-second timeout.
blocks.zh: 2 850个问题库存与路由培训文件分开储存。 除了BNG/订阅者管理之外,每条路线都贡献190个问题,贡献380个. 评委配置采用Anthropic别名claude-sonnet-4-5,温度0,2000-token评委响应极限,60秒超时.

blocks.en: 6.2 Route-Aware Judge and Validation Policy
blocks.zh: 6.2 路由和验证政策

blocks.en: Evaluation uses a route-aware five-dimension rubric. Each judge call receives the route/category, question, and generated response together with an “expert network engineer” instruction and evaluates up to five anonymized responses per batch. Model, adapter, teacher, and student identities are not included in the judge prompt. The required JSON output contains numeric scores from 0 to 5 for factual correctness, completeness, terminology/command precision, hallucination control, and operational usefulness; the scorer derives and validates the 0–25 total.
blocks.zh: 评价使用有路由意识的五元字面. 每一次法官呼叫都收到路线/类别、问题和答复,并附有“专家网络工程师”指示,每批最多评价五个匿名答复。 模型、适配器、教师和学生身份不包含在法官提示中。 所要求的JSON输出包含从0到5的数值分数,用于真实正确性、完整性、术语/命令精度、幻觉控制以及操作实用性;计分员得出并验证0至25的总数。

blocks.en: The hallucination dimension is reserved for technically false or fabricated claims, while missing or vague content is scored under completeness or terminology. This separation reduces double-penalization and keeps the rubric aligned with operational network-engineering quality. Malformed or inconsistent outputs are rejected under a bounded policy of up to three total attempts, with one- and two-second waits between attempts. Validation rejects wrong item count/order, malformed JSON, missing or out-of-range dimensions, inconsistent totals, and five-item all-zero batches. The scorer records coverage separately from quality so rejected judge batches do not silently become zero-valued model scores.
blocks.zh: 幻觉维度只用于技术上虚假或捏造的主张,而缺失或模糊的内容则按完整性或术语进行评分. 这种分离减少了双罚制,并使标题与业务网络-工程质量保持一致。 根据最多三次尝试的有限度政策,产出有缺陷或不一致的情况被拒绝,两次尝试之间有1秒和2秒的等待。 校验拒绝错误的项目计数/顺序,错误的JSON,缺失或超出范围尺寸,总量不一致,以及5项全零批次. 得分者记录覆盖率与质量分开,因此被否决的法官批次不会默默变成零值模型分数.

blocks.en: Machine-readable manifests link the raw base, CPT backbone, routed datasets, specialist adapters, resolved RSOD configuration, telemetry, checkpoints, judge rubrics, and evaluation reports. The executed CPT record fixes the fourteen inputs, tokenizer identity, 212,559 training records, 47,975,711 consumed tokens, and 3,322 optimizer steps; dataset manifests preserve per-route counts and SHA-256 identities for train and held-out artifacts. The resolved RSOD configuration fixes route ownership, optimizer/KD/rollout settings, GPU placement, and student LoRA geometry. Together with version checks, token hashes, synchronization events, and reconstruction validation, these artifacts provide the evidence layer for the model-version, token-identity, and teacher-signal invariants.

blocks.zh: 10 限制

blocks.en: Response quality is measured with an LLM-judge rubric, so the reported 0–25 values are rubric-based model-quality scores rather than executable correctness guarantees. The paper reports both the primary route-conditioned protocol and a secondary neutral deployment-like prompting condition for the final student.

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en: We present an end-to-end telecom language-model workflow spanning source-grounded structured data generation, shared continued pretraining, specialist LoRA post-training, routed specialist on-policy distillation, and networking evaluation. The executed data pipeline materializes 212,559 routed training records across fourteen routes and six specialists. RSOD consolidates the six frozen specialists into one deployable student adapter: the student generates the trajectory, the deterministic route scheduler selects one specialist, the teacher scores the exact native token sequence, and only the student LoRA is optimized. A controlled reconstruction test validates the compact teacher-signal path with 7.26 × 10 − 6 7.26\times 10^{-6} mean absolute logit error and 100% top-1 agreement between native and reconstructed teacher logits. Across 16,000 training trajectories, all recorded token-identity and serving-version checks match. Under the primary route-conditioned evaluation, the raw model scores 12.8661/25 micro, the combined routed six-teacher system scores 21.7641/25 micro over all 2,850 questions, and Llama-CalixCLM v1 reaches 21.7112/25 micro and 21.8006/25 macro; individual specialist-group means span 19.0368–22.5912/25. Under the separate neutral deployment-like prompt, the same student reaches 20.0028/25 micro and 20.0778/25 macro. Together, the data, numerical-fidelity, quality, audit, and systems measurements provide a practical path from domain-specialized networking knowledge to a single telecom-focused deployment adapter.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个端到端的电信语言模式工作流程,涵盖源头结构化的数据生成、共享持续预训、专家LORA培训后培训、路由化专家政策提炼和联网评价。 已执行的数据管道有212 559个经过14条路线的经路培训记录和6名专家。 RSOD将六位冷冻专家合并为一个可部署学生适配器:学生生成轨迹,定型路线排程器选择一名专家,老师得分精确的原生符号序列,只有学生LORA被优化. 受控重建测试以7.26×10−6.7.26\times 10×6}验证紧凑的教师-标志路径,表示绝对对帐错误和本地教师与重建教师对帐之间100%的顶级-1协议. 超过16 000个培训轨道,所有记录的符号标识和服务版本检查都相符。 在主要路线条件评价下,原始型号得分12.861/25微分,综合路线六师制得分21.7641/25微分,超过所有2850个问题,Llama-CalixCLM v1达到21.7112/25微分,21.8006/25宏;个人专家组表示跨度19.0368-22.5912/25. 在单独的中性部署式速率下,同一学生达到20.0028/25微分和20.0778/25宏. 数据、数字真实性、质量、审计和系统测量共同提供了一个从域专门联网知识到单一的以电信为重点的部署适配器的实用途径。
